name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line value-entry field that composes the canonical Input anatomy, validation variants, feedback semantics, and interaction states while exposing configurable resize direction.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Canonical Input wrapper that owns label, field, message, validation presentation, and layout.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible label explicitly associated with the native textarea.

anatomy.name: fieldBase
anatomy.description: Canonical Input field class that supplies shared typography, spacing, color, focus, hover, and disabled behavior.

anatomy.name: textareaField
anatomy.description: Textarea-specific class that provides a multi-line minimum height and configurable vertical, horizontal, or bidirectional resizing.

anatomy.name: message
anatomy.description: Optional supporting or validation message associated with the textarea.

variants.name: error
variants.description: Invalid value presentation with Error label, border, message, and focus ring.

variants.name: success
variants.description: Successful validation presentation with Success label, border, message, and focus ring.

variants.name: warning
variants.description: Attention state for values that remain valid, with Warning label, border, message, and focus ring.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default textarea size with a 120px minimum height.

states.name: hover
states.description: Inherited pointer hover state that preserves the active validation border family.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Inherited keyboard focus indicator with the shared field focus-ring hierarchy.

states.name: errorFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Error variant with semantic inner and outer borders.

states.name: successFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Success variant with semantic inner and outer borders.

states.name: warningFocusVisible
states.description: Focused Warning variant with semantic inner and outer borders.

behavior.name: labelAssociation
behavior.description: The visible label is the native textarea's accessible name and activates the field.

behavior.name: messageAssociation
behavior.description: Supporting and validation feedback is programmatically associated with the native textarea.

behavior.name: errorSemantics
attributes: role="alert" on a dynamically presented error message
behavior.description: Error presentation is paired with native invalid state and corrective feedback semantics.

behavior.name: nativeDisabled
behavior.description: Unavailable textareas use the native disabled attribute for form and focus behavior.

behavior.name: resizeDirection
attributes: data-resize="horizontal" or data-resize="both"; absence means vertical
behavior.description: The field supports vertical, horizontal, or bidirectional user resizing while preserving its 120px minimum height.

behavior.name: lineBounds
attributes: data-max-lines is absent or a positive integer greater than or equal to the effective minimum
behavior.description: Progressive enhancement converts optional line-count attributes into native resize boundaries using the field's computed typography and box metrics.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible label associated with the native textarea.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current multi-line value of the native textarea.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Optional hint shown when the textarea is empty; it does not replace the visible label.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Optional supporting or validation message associated with the textarea.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation selected from the canonical field variant list.

properties.name: resize
properties.description: Controls the native direction in which the textarea may be resized by the user.

properties.name: minLines
properties.description: Minimum visible line count allowed by native textarea resizing.

properties.name: maxLines
properties.unsetBehavior: No maximum line limit is applied.
properties.description: Optional maximum visible line count allowed by native textarea resizing; effective values never fall below minLines.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes the native textarea unavailable through its disabled attribute.

accessibility: Associate every textarea with a visible label using matching for/id attributes or an equivalent accessible name.
Use aria-describedby to connect supporting and validation messages when present.
Use aria-invalid="true" only for Error; Success and Warning do not expose invalid state.
Do not rely on validation color alone; include concise associated feedback text.
Use native disabled when the field is unavailable.
Choose vertical, horizontal, or bidirectional resizing to match the available layout without hiding content or feedback.
Use positive whole numbers for minLines and maxLines, and keep maxLines greater than or equal to minLines.

web.notes: Composes canonical Input classes with textarea__field in components/css/primitives.css.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid renders native textarea elements with input__field and textarea__field classes.
